## 4. Major AI Data Center News

- **Date:** 2026-09-25
- **Source:** [Akamai investor filing — Anthropic cloud-services commitment](https://www.ir.akamai.com/static-files/db805670-271e-406b-91a5-e0b4ed226b5a)
- **Summary:** Akamai disclosed a seven-year, $11.6B cloud-services commitment from Anthropic, with potential expansion by another $9B. The agreement supports Anthropic’s CPU workload growth; Akamai also issued Anthropic a warrant that could convert into up to roughly 5% of Akamai common stock.
- **Why it matters:** This is a large non-GPU infrastructure signal: frontier labs are locking in long-duration compute capacity beyond the dominant GPU-cloud narrative, and infrastructure vendors are using equity-linked structures to secure anchor AI workloads.

## 5. Regulation & Policy

- **Date:** 2026-09-25
- **Source:** [MIT Technology Review — The Pentagon wants $30 million to build an AI-powered lie detector](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/09/25/1145144/pentagon-ai-lie-detector/)
- **Summary:** A Department of Defense budget request seeks $30.3M over five years for “Polygraph+” / “Polygraph Next,” focused on AI/ML scoring algorithms and “standoff sensing” for next-generation deception detection.
- **Why it matters:** The proposal points to continued federal interest in using AI for high-stakes personnel screening and security functions where error rates, bias, contestability, and evidentiary standards are likely to draw scrutiny.
